prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset: illustration 01 of a nine-page original toddler picture book, "Little Bear, In It Goes!" This is ART ONLY with NO TEXT.
Create one warm, cheerful full-body GOLDEN OCHRE bear cub as a flat, authentic hand-painted tissue-paper collage on a perfectly pure white background. Original character design: broad pear-shaped golden yellow torso, slightly smaller irregular round head, two small round ears, short stout separated legs, simple long rounded paws, small pale cream oval muzzle, tiny charcoal dot eyes and small triangular dark nose, a tiny friendly curved mouth. Wears simple coral-red shorts made of two or three paper shapes. No shoes. Proportions are charmingly clumsy, not big-eyed kawaii. Both feet fully visible, one paw waves outward, the other rests relaxed beside the body. Bear angled very slightly toward the right.
Materials: actual-looking thin tissue sheets brushed with acrylic, layered ochre/gold/amber paint, visible dry-brush streaks, uneven pigment density, occasional stamped speckles and translucent overlaps. Distinct torn/cut sheets for head, ears, body, limbs, muzzle, shorts; naturally visible collage seams. Mildly irregular hand-scissor cut edges, mostly paper-defined edges without outlines. Substantial rich painterly marks, NOT a homogeneous noise texture. Flat 2D pasted paper, no paper sculptures.
Composition: square canvas, one character centered, entire silhouette within a comfortable white margin, character about 74% of canvas height. Clear white gaps between limbs, simple strong recognizable silhouette. No bin or other props on this opening image. Saturated warm primary colors, little color variation within each painted sheet. Warm classic early-childhood handmade picture-book mood.
Avoid: photography, photorealism, 3D, heavy shadows, paper relief, complex background, floor lines, plastic, smooth gradients, uniform noise overlay, detailed fur, oversized eyes, thick black contours, letters, words, numbers, logos, watermarks. Do not reuse any existing picture-book character or composition.

White bin body stays white with very subtle cool pale-gray drybrush strokes and a thin gray contour ONLY as needed to separate from the white page. Flat collage, no volume-rendered gradients. NO lid, NO handle, NO pedal, NO face or symbols. No exposed trash or dangerous objects. Keep bag liner INSIDE the bin, secured over the rim, not dangling loose.
The new bin must be entirely WHITE on its body, NOT green or cream. Thin subtle gray outlines are allowed to make white-on-white sides visible. Delete the green lid and handle completely. The dark black oval opening and folded black liner must be unmistakable. Same bin scale and location. Authentic flat hand-painted tissue-paper collage with lightly irregular cut edges. No text, logos, watermarks, extra props or scenery.
